name: Review reason spotter
why: Ranks why people chose the app from 20 or more reviews, with exact quotes, which feeds the keyword map and the first screenshot.

name: Star-rating review miner
why: Reads rival apps' reviews by star rating for gaps and broken promises, useful before writing a listing that answers them.

name: Mine your product's own words and find the shared want
why: Sorts the app's own phrases for headlines and finds the one want users share, a good start for the subtitle and short description.

name: Write headlines and pick the winner with a small test
why: Writes checked headline options and a small test, handy for screenshot captions and promotional text before a store test.

name: One-change experiment planner
why: Turns a question into a test that changes one thing, the same discipline the store page test skill uses.

name: Experiment readout desk
why: Checks a test plan before it starts and gives an honest verdict when it ends, a second look for store listing tests.

name: Test result trust checker
why: Checks whether a finished test can be trusted (split, run length, early stopping) before a winner is applied.

name: Review reply batch writer
why: Writes a specific public reply to each review and flags risky ones, useful for App Store and Google Play review replies.

name: Public review reply desk
why: Keeps review replies going batch by batch and flags repeat complaints that the listing or the next release should address.

name: Set up product tracking and build a retention dashboard
why: Plans the app events and return-rate view that push and in-app message triggers and results depend on.

name: Customer onboarding keeper
why: Finds the step where new users stall each week, which tells the message map where a nudge would help.

name: Make onboarding instructions match the product
why: Fixes first-use instructions that name moved or missing buttons, so in-app tips and tooltips point to real screens.
